# Air Apps

> > Air Apps provides AI-powered mobile tools including Translate Now for multilingual translation, QR Code Reader & Barcode Scanner, and Calculator Air for photo math solving.

Air Apps specializes in mobile applications that leverage AI and OCR technology to solve everyday challenges. Their flagship products include Translate Now (AI translation across 300+ languages via text, voice, and image), QR Code Reader & Barcode Scanner, and Calculator Air's photo math solver.

## Translation Tools & Features

- [AI Translator for Human-Like Accurate Results](https://airapps.co/translate/ai-translation): AI Translator with human-like accuracy in 300+ languages via text, voice, image
- [Image Translation for Signs, Menus, & Documents](https://airapps.co/translate/image-translation): Translate Now camera translation for signs, menus, and documents using OCR
- [English to German Language Translator for Daily Use](https://airapps.co/translate/english-german): English-German translator with text, speech, and camera translation features

## QR Code & Barcode Tools

- [QR Code Reader & Barcode Scanner App | Generate QR Codes](https://airapps.co/qr-code): QR Code Reader & Barcode Scanner: scan, generate, compare prices, organize

## Math & Education Tools

- [Photo Math Solver with Step by Step Answers](https://airapps.co/calculator/photo-math): Calculator Air photo math solver: scan handwritten/printed problems with OCR AI
